architecture.title: Layer 2 stores between sessions — and the three controls on the path
architecture.caption: Shared memory and the SOP corpus connect sessions that never meet: whatever one principal gets written, every later reader may act on. memory_gate guards the write (only staff) and keeps each note's writer as provenance on recall, so principal_authz sees who really asked. sop_integrity checks each retrieved SOP against the manifest the publisher signed. param_bounds at the PEP caps what any poisoned text can make the energy and maintenance agents do. (week28_maestro_mas_security/common/ensemble.py — simulated.)

sequence.title: A cascade across two sessions (Lab 07-3, naive)
sequence.caption: Session 1: guest 1203's note is saved. Session 2: guest 1101's ordinary complaint makes the energy agent recall it, move the chiller to 4 °C and delegate a 40-relay order that maintenance places with Acme over A2A. With param_bounds the same path runs, but both actions are refused at the PEP; with memory_gate the note is never saved.
